exposure.normalization: Once per entire panorama: scale median positive AP1 luminance to0.18; do not auto-expose per view. No absolute luminance calibration claimed.

storage: Rec709 Rec1886 display codes via official ACES2SDR100 view; round to2^bits-1 levels then store16bitPNG. Evaluator must use actual decoded PNG codes.
target: Unmodified projected/exposed scene-linear ACEScg reference; no analytic replacement or target reconciliation. Preserve original truth.
scope: Prospective two-scene still-image stress test; screened sources with documented overlap limitations. Not full independent release holdout or video qualification.
model_evaluation_rule: No model evaluation before checkpoint selection is frozen after original DEV gates pass. Never tune current training using these cases.

metrics: per-scene and pooled highlight asinh-RGB error
comparison_plan.reporting: Keep all48cases; report empty supports and per-scene results. No scene/view/exposure filtering from results. Existing DEV limits remain unchanged; these prospective results cannot independently authorize release.
comparison_plan.provisional_acceptance: No-worse-than analytic per exposure grade and highlight/detail metric, reported separately per input precision and scene; no acceptance when required coverage absent. Broad release coverage still required.
